subject: Re: Mutual action plan & acceptance timeline — NovaMed marketplace PO
messages:
From: Natalie Chen <natalie.chen@novamed.com>
To: jasmine.liu@redwood.ai; procurement@novamed.com
Date: 2028-07-05T10:23:00-07:00
Subject: Marketplace purchase MAP & next steps

Hi Jasmine —

Thanks for the intro call earlier. We're ready to move from evaluation to PO, but procurement needs a clear MAP and acceptance criteria tied to the marketplace private offer flow (we're planning AWS private offer for prod and a short-term GCP test environment). Can you share a mutual action plan that:

- Lists evaluation milestones and owners
- Shows acceptance gates (functionality + performance) and signoff steps
- Explains the billing path and invoice cadence for a marketplace private offer
- Includes the PO template your finance team prefers

We'd like to hit acceptance and have invoicing start on Oct 1; procurement needs an outline by EOD next Wednesday.

Relevant internal contacts: Erin (CFO) and procurement@novamed.com (cc'd).

Cheers,
Natalie
Director, Cloud Ops
NovaMed
From: jasmine.liu@redwood.ai <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Natalie Chen <natalie.chen@novamed.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai; lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-07-06T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace purchase MAP & next steps

Hi Natalie —

Appreciate the clear ask. Attached is a first-pass MAP and the PO template for NovaMed (SOW_redwood-novamed_v1.pdf; PO_NovaMed_20280712.xlsx). Below is a condensed MAP summary you can share with procurement:

Mutual Action Plan (high level)
1) Eval window (2 weeks):
   - Kickoff test accounts (GCP test project) — owner: NovaMed Cloud Team (due 2028-07-10)
   - Baseline perf tests (99th pct latency targets, token throughput) — owner: Redwood SE (due 2028-07-17)
2) Acceptance criteria (functional + perf):
   - Feature: streaming responses, function-calling compatibility, embedding parity
   - Perf: p95 < 300ms for 512-token requests in test; sustained throughput for batch jobs (as per SOW appendix)
   - Security: SOC2 evidence + VPC peering checklist completed
   - Signoff: NovaMed prod owner + Redwood AE (handoff doc in Drive)
3) Marketplace private offer & billing path:
   - Production procurement via AWS Private Offer (Marketplace). Redwood will provide the private offer terms and line-item SKU mapping to enable automated invoice flow through AWS invoicing to NovaMed (Finance contact on file).
   - Interim billing (if requested) via Redwood invoice for pilot usage on GCP test project; final commercial start date set on acceptance gate (expected target 2028-10-01).
   - Invoices: monthly in arrears; payment terms Net30 unless otherwise agreed in PO.
4) Legal/finance steps:
   - Redwood to send final SOW and PO template (attached).
   - NovaMed to provide signed PO back to procurement@redwood.ai and procurement@novamed.com.
5) Rollout cadence:
   - Week 0: Kickoff & test environment access
   - Week 1: Integration + smoke tests
   - Week 2: Perf eval + acceptance signoff

Please find the SOW with acceptance tests in appendix A and a simple invoice-path diagram attached (invoice-path-diagram.png). If this looks good I can route through our marketplace onboarding team and Karthik can confirm the discount/commit phrasing for the private offer.

Action items for procurement: please confirm (a) the preferred legal entity name for AWS Private Offer, (b) CFO contact for billing, and (c) whether Net30 terms are acceptable.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOW_redwood-novamed_v1.pdf (SOW draft — acceptance tests), PO_NovaMed_20280712.xlsx (PO template), invoice-path-diagram.png (diagram)
From: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: jasmine.liu@redwood.ai; lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: natalie.chen@novamed.com
Date: 2028-07-08T11:11:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace purchase MAP & next steps

Jasmine — quick additions from legal/finance before we finalize the MAP:

- Commit & discount language: Recommend replacing 'discount' with 'volume-based tiering' in private offer to keep marketplace SKU mapping clean. I'll provide suggested phrasing by EOD Monday.
- AWS Private Offer billing mechanics: We need the exact legal entity (EIN) and billing contact for the Private Offer enrollment. NovaMed should confirm whether they want invoices routed through AWS Marketplace or a direct post-acceptance invoicing model (we prefer Marketplace routing to keep procurement simple).
- Acceptance signoff: Add a 48-hour window for test remediation after failing perf tests; this protects both sides.

Also tagging Lauren to confirm whether our onboarding team needs any additional API keys or SRE runbooks for the NovaMed environment.

Karthik Iyer
Director, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Natalie Chen <natalie.chen@novamed.com>
To: jasmine.liu@redwood.ai; karthik.iyer@redwood.ai; lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-07-12T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan & acceptance timeline — NovaMed marketplace PO

Thanks, team — this is helpful. Quick answers: 

- Legal entity: NovaMed Technologies, Inc. (EIN: 12-3456789) — I'll attach the signed PO (attached: PO_NovaMed_20280712.xlsx stub).
- CFO contact: Erin Wallace <erin.wallace@novamed.com> (copied on follow-up with procurement).
- Net30 is acceptable.

Please confirm next steps to enroll the private offer and any paperwork Redwood needs to complete on its side.

Natalie

NovaMed
